name: CI/CD Deploy to Oracle Cloud

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ] # 메인 브랜치에 푸시될 때 실행

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      # 1. Java 및 빌드 환경 설정
      - name: Set up JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v3
        with:
          java-version: '21' 
          distribution: 'temurin'

      # 2. 스프링 부트 빌드 (Maven 버전)
      - name: Build Spring Boot
        run: |
          cd spring_chs_mini
          chmod +x mvnw
          ./mvnw clean package -DskipTests

      # 3. Docker Buildx 설정
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v2

      # 4. Docker Hub 로그인
      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v2
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

      # 5. 이미지 빌드 및 푸시 (Express 및 파이썬 추가)
      - name: Build and Push Images
        run: |
          docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 -t ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/spring-app:latest ./spring_chs_mini --push
          docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 -t ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/react-app:latest ./react_chs_mini --push
          docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 -t ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/stock-ai:latest ./stock-ai --push
          # 🚀 --- Express 로봇 모니터링 백엔드 추가 ---
          docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 -t ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/express-app:latest ./expressjs_backend --push

      # 6. 오라클 서버에 SSH 접속하여 배포
      - name: Deploy to Server
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@master
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.SERVER_IP }}
          username: ubuntu
          key: ${{ secrets.SERVER_KEY }}
          script: |
            # 1. 기존 컨테이너 정리 (Express 컨테이너 추가 제거)
            docker rm -f spring-container react-container python-container express-container 2>/dev/null || true

            # 2. 최신 이미지 풀 (Express 추가)
            docker pull ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/spring-app:latest
            docker pull ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/react-app:latest
            docker pull ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/stock-ai:latest
            docker pull ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/express-app:latest
            
            # 3. 파이썬 AI 서버 실행
            docker run -d --name python-container \
              -p 8000:8000 \
              -e KIS_APP_KEY="${{ secrets.APP_KEY }}" \
              -e KIS_APP_SECRET="${{ secrets.APP_SECRET }}" \
              -e KIS_URL_BASE="https://openapi.koreainvestment.com:9443" \
              --restart always \
              ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/stock-ai:latest

            # 4. 스프링 컨테이너 실행
            docker run -d --name spring-container \
              -p 8080:8080 \
              -v /home/ubuntu/upload:/upload \
              --link python-container:python-api \
              --restart always \
              ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/spring-app:latest

            # 🚀 5. Express 로봇 백엔드 컨테이너 실행 (Supabase DB 접속 계정 주입)
            # 수동으로 주입하던 환경변수를 GitHub Secrets 시스템을 통해 안전하게 주입합니다.
            docker run -d --name express-container \
              -p 5000:5000 \
              -e DB_USER="${{ secrets.DB_USER }}" \
              -e DB_PASSWORD="${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}" \
              -e DB_HOST="${{ secrets.DB_HOST }}" \
              -e DB_PORT="${{ secrets.DB_PORT }}" \
              -e DB_DATABASE="${{ secrets.DB_DATABASE }}" \
              --restart always \
              ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/express-app:latest
              
            # 6. 리액트 컨테이너 실행
            docker run -d --name react-container \
              -p 80:80 \
              --restart always \
              ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/react-app:latest

            # 7. 미사용 이미지 정리 (용량 확보)
            docker image prune -f
